subtitle: 拆不拆，用同一份验收集说话

question.zh-CN: 一个上下文装下任务、规则和四份资料，一次请求出完三道题。
question.en: One context holds the task, the rule and all four documents; one request writes all three questions.

exercises.title: 固定流程：研究 → 出题 → 审核

question.zh-CN: 程序按顺序发三个新请求，每一步只拿到程序交给它的东西。
question.en: The program sends three fresh requests in order; each step gets only what the program hands it.

exercises.title: 角色切换：同一份消息历史

question.zh-CN: 同一个 Agent 依次换上研究员、出题人、审核人的系统提示词，消息历史一直共享。
question.en: One agent puts on the researcher, writer and reviewer system prompts in turn; the message history stays shared.

exercises.title: 独立多 Agent：并行研究、合并、出题、审核

question.zh-CN: 三个研究员各看一部分资料并行工作，程序合并事实，再交给独立的出题人和审核人。
question.en: Three researchers each read part of the documents in parallel, the program merges the facts, then an independent writer and reviewer take over.

exercises.title: 独立多 Agent：交接包带规则

question.zh-CN: 做法同上，只在每个研究员的交接包里多加一条规则：d4 是旧版草稿，已经过时。
question.en: Same as above, except every researcher's handoff package also carries one rule: d4 is an old draft and out of date.

ui.question_help: 任务、资料和验收集都是固定的；这里的文字只记为备注，不会发给模型。
